<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development hereby
permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the Demolition and
Construction Logistics Plan approved under approval of details application P/2137/23
dated 12/09/2023 unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning
authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved
details and shall thereafter be retained<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development hereby
permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the Fire Safety
Statement approved under approval of details application P/0509/23 dated 31/01/24
unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The
development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and
shall thereafter be retained<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with
details of the </span><span lang="EN-US" style="">waste
management plan</span><span lang="EN-US" style=""> </span><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">approved under approval of details application </span>PL/0843/24 <span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">dated 16/05/2024 unless otherwise agreed in
writing with the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out
in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained</span>.&nbsp;<span lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The development hereby
permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the materials
approved under approval of details application P/0362/23 dated 25/01/24 unless
otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The development
shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall
thereafter be retained<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Prior to occupation, details of the
provision of green/biodiverse roofs within the development have been submitted
to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The details to be submitted
shall comprise:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">a) identification of the roof areas
to be used for the provision of<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">green/biodiverse roofs;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">b) details of the planting and
substrate to be used, including roof build<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">up, plant species/mix(es) schedule
which should include at least 20<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">native flower species, plans and
sections as appropriate; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">c) details of the maintenance including
irrigation.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development shall be carried
out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained and
maintained as such thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Evidence of certification of Secure
by Design Accreditation for the development (silver of gold) shall be submitted
to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any part of
the development is occupied or used.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Notwithstanding the drawings hereby
approved, each unit shall be provided&nbsp;</span>with openable windows.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The flat roof areas of the building
beyond any balconies or terraces, hereby&nbsp;</span>permitted shall not be used as a
balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further
specific permission from the local planning authority.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">Notwithstanding the provisions of
the Electronic Communications Code&nbsp;</span>Regulation 5 (2003) in accordance
with The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
Order 2015 (or any order revoking or reenacting that order with or without
modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Schedule 2,
Part 16, Class A of that order shall be carried out in relation to the
development hereby permitted without the prior written permission of the local
planning authority.</p>
